args.message:
Hello,

Please review the redline for the renewal of the courier services contract (CTR-310). The counterparty has provided feedback on three points:
1. Clause 8 - the revised liability cap is acceptable.
2. Clause 12 - they prefer the notice period to remain at 60 days instead of the proposed 30.
3. They suggest adding a clause for a fuel-surcharge review twice a year.

Best,
Your Contract Team
